+    @app.get("/api/account-number/check")
+    def check_account_number(number: str) -> dict[str, bool]:
+        valid = (
+            number.startswith("YMS-")
+            and number[4:8].isdigit()
+            and number[8:9] == "-"
+            and number[9:13].isdigit()
+            and len(number) >= 13
+        )
+        return {"valid": valid}
